# Codex allowance and needs-input alerts

This release adds a Codex allowance rim and reset countdown, distinct working,
needs-input, and done indicators, and separate sounds for input requests and
completion. Weather and usage retain useful cached readings, with a history
marker and tap-to-view update age. Recovery refreshes overdue sources. Low battery and allowance are highlighted at 20% or less.

Update both the desktop client and watch firmware. Allowance tracking uses
Omarchy's agents panel; needs-input alerts require the optional
[Omarchy Watch for Codex v0.2.0](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch-codex/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
companion. After updating the companion, start a new Codex session and review
the changed hooks with `/hooks`.

The flash bundle preserves existing pairing and settings. See the
[update guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#update) for instructions.
